name: Ethernet wrap-around
description: A band that goes right round the cable (about 1.5 turns, so it sticks to itself). The name is repeated round it, so it reads from any side and from either end.

fields.label: Names, one per line
fields.example:
SW1 PORT 1
SW1 PORT 2
NAS
DESK
fields.hint: Each name gets its own label piece

fields.label: Copies of each
fields.hint: 2 = one for each end of the cable
